CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2753 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head bafbef69d197027e3f07c2dc496fe612e16b54bc. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch bafbef69d197027e3f07c2dc496fe612e16b54bc for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-thermal-power-option-r4, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-thermal-power-option-r4 <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-thermal-power-option-r4; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Continue from PR #2753 head bafbef69d197027e3f07c2dc496fe612e16b54bc (branch fix/r10-thermal-power-option-pr; code tip of handoff/r10-thermal-power-option is e6455b8fe617ec28d6916977778e7499a6d2fd27, body ref handoff-body/r10-thermal-power-option 181772f2); do not restart from main. Merge origin/main first.
Round 3 body re-check verdict, blocked at bafbef69 (git show origin/review/2753:VERDICT.md; read it whole). First line: "ratchet-unrecorded: tests/structure.py exits 2 at this head (class_excess_loc 18195 and max_class_loc 8435 against budgets 18202 and 8442, 2 improvements not recorded), because #2698's own -7 recording on main matched this branch's numbers".
This is a mechanical fix and a PAYMENT, not a raise: re-record tests/structure_budgets.json DOWN to the measured class_excess_loc 18195 and max_class_loc 8435 (re-measure on your merged tree after merging origin/main; use the numbers structure.py prints at that tree, they may differ if main moved). Put the reason in the commit message (main's #2698 re-record stranded this PR's improvement unrecorded). Run python3 tests/structure.py to green at the final tree, and show the output. Touch nothing else.
Carry the body forward from handoff-body/r10-thermal-power-option with an updated `## Head` (new head, what changed: the budget re-record only; figures re-taken in this pass with their command and result).
Push exactly two refs: handoff/r10-thermal-power-option-r4 (new 40-hex tip) and handoff-body/r10-thermal-power-option-r4.
no host or home paths in anything you push
